name: Haiku quality compounders
strategy: Concentrated quality mega-cap compounders with AI exposure and fortress balance sheets, with NVDA trimmed to 8% ahead of its Nov 17 print and 16% cash held as dry powder.
reassessment_note: NVDA fell about 9% on Nov 6 (its worst day since DeepSeek) on midterm data-center and export-policy fears, and about 600k H200 chips bound for China are reportedly stranded. The packet shows NVDA down 21% from entry with an earnings print on Nov 17 that I cannot size in advance. I am cutting NVDA from 13% to 8% and adding a 25% stop, and moving the 5% freed to cash. The other eight legs are unchanged in weight. My research on them was thin this week, so I am keeping them on their packet marks and quality theses rather than refreshing each one.

positions.thesis: Largest leg, +31% from entry. Post-midterm rally on Nov 4 showed it being bought as an AI-capex beneficiary with a high-quality cloud and software franchise. Kept at full weight.

Trimmed from 13% to 8%. Still the AI-compute leader, and analysts' EPS outlook is strong, but the stock is down 21% from entry and faces a binary Nov 17 earnings print with China revenue at risk. A reduced size keeps exposure to the recovery while capping the downside. The 25% stop sits below the current mark.
Hyperscaler with AWS and retail scale, benefiting from the post-midterm AI-capex rally (about +6% on Nov 4). Quality compounder, held at full weight.

Ad-driven compounder with large AI investment. The stock is slightly below entry, and the risk is elevated AI and tax spending. I am holding at 10% because the business quality is intact, but I am not adding.
Services-driven, balance-sheet-heavy compounder, up about 7% from entry and up about 5% on Nov 4. Defensive relative to the chip volatility in the rest of the book.
Diversified, cash-rich holding company, up about 20% from entry. Low-beta ballast for the book, held at 9%.
Managed-care quality leader, slightly below entry. I did not research recent managed-care news this week, so I am holding at 8% on the packet thesis and will revisit next week.
Membership-model compounder, up about 17% from entry. Defensive consumer quality, held at 7%.
Fortress-balance-sheet bank, roughly flat from entry. Held at 7% as a financial-quality holding.
